chunks: Mansur ibn Yunus Buzurj asked him about a man who strives to cry during the obligatory salat (prayer) until he weeps.
He said: “It is a comfort of the eye, by Allah.”
And he, peace be upon him, said: “When that happens, then remember me at that moment.”

key_terms.عِنْدَهُ: at that moment or in that state
key_terms.قُرَّةُ عَيْنٍ: a source of delight, comfort, and joy
key_terms.يَتَبَاكَى: strives to bring himself to weep

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about weeping during obligatory salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith praises a state of heartfelt weeping in obligatory salat (prayer), presenting it as something noble and spiritually pleasing. It also instructs the believer to remember the Imam عليه السلام in such a softened and spiritually receptive moment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.940 - Mansur ibn Yunus Buzurj asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about a person who strives to cry during the obligatory prayer until tears flow.
Imam (as) replied: "It is a source of great joy, by Allah (swt)."
The Imam also said: "When this happens, remember me in that moment”.
